Abstract Visualizing iso-surfaces of volumetric data sets is becoming increasingly important for many practi-cal applications. One crucial task in iso-surface ray tracing is to find the correct intersection of a ray with the trilinear-interpolated implicit surface de-fined by the data values at the vertices of a given voxel.
